_comment: Baseline snapshot: the TaintBench finding IDs ctadl detects today via a connected source->sink path. 9 of the 17 positive flows connect. Every finding's source and sink is recognized as an endpoint. The negative(s) [19] share their callee pair with a positive, so they are shadowed and do not count as false positives. ctadl reports the negative(s) [16, 20] as flows. That is imprecision we have measured and written down here; a negative outside this list still fails the check. See ../../README.md.
